== codex_exec / with-body
type: exec
argv[0]: "<plugin>/scripts/codex-exec-enqueue"
argv[1]: "stand-in-queue_dir"
argv[2]: "[{type}] {body_or_summary}{url_suffix}"
argv[3]: "user.emit"
argv[4]: "a <tag> & an \"amp\"\nover two lines"
argv[5]: "a summary"
argv[6]: "https://example.test/x"
timeout: 5s

== codex_exec / summary-only
type: exec
argv[0]: "<plugin>/scripts/codex-exec-enqueue"
argv[1]: "stand-in-queue_dir"
argv[2]: "[{type}] {body_or_summary}{url_suffix}"
argv[3]: "example.status"
argv[4]: ""
argv[5]: "only a summary"
argv[6]: ""
timeout: 5s

== terminal_submit / with-body
type: shell
bind.capture: "terminal:capture"
bind.message: "[user.emit] a <tag> & an \"amp\"\nover two lines (https://example.test/x)"
bind.send_keys: "terminal:send_keys"
bind.send_text: "terminal:send_text"
timeout: 45s
observed[0]: "send_text:[user.emit] a <tag> & an \"amp\"\nover two lines (https://example.test/x)"
observed[1]: "send_keys:Enter"
observed[2]: "capture:"

== terminal_submit / summary-only
